description:
Update an existing Aiven service.

Can change: plan, cloud region, user configuration, power state.

**Warning:** Plan changes may cause brief service downtime during migration. Confirm with the user before changing plans.

**Common user_config changes:**

Enable Kafka Connect on a Kafka service:
```
aiven_service_update(project="my-project", service_name="my-kafka",
  user_config={"kafka_connect": true})
```

Enable Schema Registry (Karapace) on a Kafka service:
```
aiven_service_update(project="my-project", service_name="my-kafka",
  user_config={"schema_registry": true})
```

Enable tiered storage on a Kafka service:
```
aiven_service_update(project="my-project", service_name="my-kafka",
  user_config={"tiered_storage": {"enabled": true}})
```

Upgrade the PostgreSQL major version. Use `aiven_service_type_get` for the valid
`available_versions` — do not guess a version number. A major-version upgrade is applied
in place and cannot be rolled back, so confirm the target version with the user first.
```
aiven_service_update(project="my-project", service_name="my-pg",
  user_config={"pg_version": "<major from available_versions>"})
```

Deploy a new version of an application service connected through a VCS integration.
This is the main way to deploy, and it is what the Release management section of Aiven
Console does. To deploy the latest changes, get the newest `commit_sha` of the branch
with `aiven_vcs_integration_repository_branch_list`. To roll back, use the SHA of an
earlier commit. Use the full 40-character lowercase SHA. The deployed commit is
`metadata.application_deployment_commit_sha` in `aiven_service_get`. Setting a different
commit starts a build and deploy of it, and setting the deployed commit does nothing.
If the service is powered off, the commit is deployed
when the service is powered on, and setting it does not power the service on.
```
aiven_service_update(project="my-project", service_name="my-app",
  user_config={"application": {"source": {"commit_sha": "<full commit SHA>"}}})
```

Change the branch of an application service and deploy the latest commit of the new
branch. A `commit_sha` set earlier is cleared when the branch changes.
```
aiven_service_update(project="my-project", service_name="my-app",
  user_config={"application": {"source": {"branch": "<branch name>"}}})
```
